links.comparator_used: Colposcopists reading unaided, without AI assistance (AI standalone sensitivity of 84.2% also reported)
links.outcome: Sensitivity for CIN2+ detection, with AUC in low-experience colposcopists and mean biopsies per case
links.effect: Colposcopist sensitivity rose from 84.8% (95% CI 82.7–86.9%) to 90.6% (95% CI 88.7–92.1%) with AI assistance. Among low-experience colposcopists, sensitivity increased by 6.5% and AUC went from 0.72 (95% CI 0.68–0.77) to 0.76 (95% CI 0.72–0.80; p = 0.043). Mean biopsies per case fell from 2.48 to 2.02.
links.quote: With AI assistance, colposcopists sensitivity increased from 84.8% (95% CI, 82.7–86.9%) to 90.6% (95% CI, 88.7–92.1%).

design_hint: external validation on independent dataset; AI assistance vs unaided colposcopist reading
